blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines — Filipino Olympian Samantha Catantan fell one victory short of securing an Asian Games 2026 fencing medal in the women’s individual foil on Wednesday. Catantan fell to South Korea’s Park Jihee in the quarterfinal, 15-10, ending her campaign. “I’m really proud with how I fenced today. Up to the end, I did not give up. So I’m very proud of that. Unfortunately, it’s sports, it could go either way,” said an emotional Catantan. Catantan advanced to the last eight after beating Macau’s Hio Lam Ku, 15-13, in […]...
